story.title: Founder, Architect, Hacker
paragraphs: I'm the founder of Next Jedi, where AI stops being a feature and becomes the company. Next Jedi makes bold products that help people learn, play and connect, imagined by a founder, then built, launched and operated by AI agents around the clock, with cutting-edge AI pushed to its fullest potential at every step.

I'm a senior software architect with a decade of experience, including Gartner and Crossover, working with Fortune 500 companies across the globe. At Gartner I was the architect behind a flagship cybersecurity intelligence platform that hundreds of CISOs at the world's largest enterprises rely on to benchmark and defend their organisations. Long before the era of LLMs, I conceived and led an AI platform that orchestrated eleven machine-learning models in concert, technology strong enough that it was spun out into a company of its own. I've also helped shape blockchain policy and led full-time blockchain enablement across projects, including government contracts.

At heart I'm a hacker who never stopped competing. A 5x hackathon winner and three-time national finalist of Code Gladiators, one of India's largest coding contests, I'm passionate about creating things that change the way we do things, for good.
highlights: Founded Next Jedi, where AI agents build, launch and operate the products, with one app live and six more in development.
Architected Gartner's cybersecurity benchmarking platform, used by 720+ CISOs and 2,500+ users across Fortune 500 companies and a primary driver of $5m+ in contract renewals.
Conceived and led an AI document-processing platform orchestrating 11 ML models at 99% accuracy, which led to the formation of Curl HG.
Built a blockchain practice from inception to a 12-person team, covering asset tokenization and self-sovereign identity, and contributed to government blockchain proposals.
Architected a code-generation framework that automates 75% of application development, adopted across 15+ teams.
5x hackathon winner, including 1st place at the IBM Bluemix National Hackathon (2015), and Alexa Hackathon finalist (top 25 nationally).
3x Code Gladiators national finalist (top 300 of 250,000+ developers) and CodeChef SnackDown global rank 445.
Spoke at Genesis DevCon and the International Blockchain Congress, and guest lectured on blockchain at BVBCET Hubli and GAT Bangalore.
Certified in Design & Analysis of Algorithms by Microsoft Research.
